assumption: llama.cpp binaries and a 7B GGUF with a same-tokenizer tiny draft are available locally, so draft and n-gram modes can be run.
rationale: The comparison study cannot start without llama.cpp's speculative tools and GGUF models on disk. This is a local-only check with no download. It reports what is present and does not claim that a matching draft exists on the hub, which is unknown from the context.
expected: At least one llama.cpp speculative or lookup binary found, one 7B Q4-sized GGUF (3.5-6 GB) and one tiny GGUF (<1.5 GB).
